slides.stem: The equation $x^2 + y^2 + 8x - 10y + 5 = 0$ represents a circle in the $xy$-plane. What is the area of this circle?

slides.intro: Complete the square; the right side is already $r^2$.
slides.trapWhy: $6\pi$ plugs $r = 6$ where the formula wants $r^2$. The $36$ never needed a root.

slides.title: The right side is r² already
slides.body:
Completing the square leaves $r^2$ alone on the right. Area is $\pi r^2$, so the number is ready the moment the square is complete.

Taking the root and re-squaring is where the wrong answers come from.
